newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud to buy three firms by end Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Exbud to buy three firms by end Q1 1997.

text.p: Polish construction company Exbud SA wants to buy two construction and one engineering firms in the next few months, the financial director of the company said on Wednesday.

Leszek Walczyk said Exbud wanted to buy 75-percent stakes in two construction firms based in the northern city of Gdansk and western city of Poznan later this year and about 50 percent in an engineering firm based in the south-eastern city of Rzeszow.
"We will buy two construction firms in 1996 and one engineering company in early 1997," he told Reuters, but declined to give any details.
Exbud recenly bought stakes in a construction firm, a bridge construction company and an engineering firm.

Walczyk also said the company, whose printing subsidiary Poligrafia will begin initial public offering in November, planned floating another of its about 20 subsidaries next year and several others in 1998.

"Several firms of our holding will be placed on the bourse, some of them even on the main market ... we take into account both newly acquired subsidaries and firms, which have been in our holding for a longer time," he said.
